about_the_game:
Rolling Core is a challenging 2D platformer set within the halls of an ancient, long-dormant factory, now awakening after centuries of silence.

You are a single cog that has broken free when the factory stirs back to life. Your goal: escape. But the way out is far from simple. Each level is filled with moving machinery, shifting platforms, and vigilant robots determined to stop you.

Progress through the factory from its dark, forgotten lower depths to the bright, humming upper floors. Along the way, you’ll unlock new abilities that will open up fresh ways to navigate and survive.

The factory is alive. Corridors reconfigure themselves, platforms shift unexpectedly, and hazards appear where none were before. Sometimes, the environment changes right under your feet.

Features:

  • Atmospheric journey from dark, abandoned ruins to vibrant, active machinery

  • Evolving abilities that enhance movement and strategy

  • Dynamic, changing levels that keep you on your toes

  • Environmental puzzles and switch-based encounters instead of direct combat

  • Boss encounters at the end of each stage

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or later / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or later / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL 4.5 support or Steam Deck’s AMD APU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Rolling Core is a 2D platformer set inside a colossal, ancient factory coming back to life. Play as a small machine part breaking free, navigating shifting machinery, evading hostile robots, and unlocking new abilities to escape the factory’s ever-changing depths.
